Event: `69b71b871ff1f6df80270dd9fd5b5fd7` · 2026-09-26T03:27:49Z

> Verdict: MERGE. No findings above P3.
> 
> 8a (one definition each): USER_AREA_END is now in redoubt-sys, rv32 0x8000_0000 and rv64 0x40_0000_0000, chosen by target_pointer_width. That is identical to the old libs/abi arch values. The loader's private USER_STACK_TOP is 0x8000_0000, as before. PAGE_SIZE is 4096 everywhere.
> 8b (PageError fold): the rewritten arch mem.rs address_available (walk -> empty slot, or any walk error -> free) behaves like the old virt_to_phys == Err(BadAddress). Both treat NonCanonical/superpage/no-table as 'free' and any reservation or loan alias as taken. Its callers (mem.rs:379/396) search only the default and message windows inside user space, so the 'free' answer on a walk error is never reached for a kernel address. The R11 check (BadFlags) and the Lent/InUse refusals keep distinct variants, and no .ok()/is_ok() site in the diff turns a refusal into success.
> 8c (libs/layout): every kernel-half constant is value-identical to libs/abi's on both widths: PHYSMAP_BASE/PHYS_BASE/SIZE, KERNEL_AREA, KERNEL_STACK_TOP, TRAP_STACK_TOP (was EXCEPTION_STACK_TOP), KERNEL_PLIC_BASE, PROCESS_AREA (== THREAD_CONTEXT_AREA), KERNEL_DMA_REGS. The layout crate is #![forbid(unsafe_code)], and its budget is 0/0 (redoubt-abi's 52/44 is gone). The unsafe ratchet moves as planned.
> 
> P3-1 address_available's 'walk error -> free' is safe only because of its callers' windows. A one-line debug_assert!(virt < USER_AREA_END) would make that structural.
> No plants this round: 8a-8c is a move/rename with value parity, and the attack cases planted in r2-r4 cover the paths.
